record.original_question: For a prime Fano threefold of index 1 or 2, when does its Kuznetsov component admit Serre-invariant stability conditions?

evidence.quote: Question 5.15. When does the Kuznetsov component of a prime Fano threefold with index 1 or 2 admit Serre-invariant stability conditions?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth prime Fano threefold over the complex numbers (i.e., a smooth Fano threefold with Picard rank 1) of index 1 or 2. Let $D^b(X)$ denote the bounded derived category of coherent sheaves on $X$, and let $\mathcal{K}u(X) \subset D^b(X)$ denote its Kuznetsov component, defined as follows:
- If $\mathrm{ind}(X) = 2$, then $\mathcal{K}u(X) = \langle \mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{O}_X(1)\rangle^{\perp}$.
- If $\mathrm{ind}(X) = 1$, then $\mathcal{K}u(X) = \langle \mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{E}\rangle^{\perp}$, where $\mathcal{E}$ is a suitable exceptional rank-2 bundle on $X$ (when one exists).

A Bridgeland stability condition $\sigma = (\mathcal{A}, Z)$ on $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is called Serre-invariant if $S(\sigma) = \sigma \cdot \widetilde{g}$ for some $\widetilde{g}$ in the universal cover of $\mathrm{GL}^+_2(\mathbb{R})$, where $S$ denotes the Serre functor of $\mathcal{K}u(X)$.

Determine, for each deformation type of prime Fano threefold $X$ of index 1 or 2, whether $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ admits a Serre-invariant Bridgeland stability condition.
artifact.status_search_result: Existence of Serre-invariant stability conditions has been established for Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds of index 2 (del Pezzo threefolds) and of index 1 (with results covering genus ≥ 6 and further cases via Hochschild–Serre algebra techniques), and uniqueness (up to the universal cover of GL⁺₂(ℝ)) is known for fractional Calabi–Yau categories of dimension ≤ 2. A full classification across all deformation types of prime Fano threefolds of index 1 and 2 is, however, not completely settled in the literature; in particular, non-existence has been shown for many higher-codimension Fano complete intersections. The question therefore appears partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Stability manifolds of Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: All Serre-invariant stability conditions on Ku(X) form a contractible connected component of the stability manifold; results for prime Fano 3-folds of index 1 and 2.
status_evidence.claim: Serre-invariant stability conditions exist and are essentially unique for prime Fano threefolds of index 1 and 2 in the cases treated.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: A fractional Calabi-Yau category of dimension at most 2 admits a unique Serre-invariant stability condition up to GL+_2(R).
status_evidence.claim: Existence/uniqueness shown for cubic threefolds and analogous index-2 cases.

status_evidence.title: Kuznetsov's Fano threefold conjecture via Hochschild–Serre algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Further existence results for Serre-invariant stability conditions on Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds of index 1.
status_evidence.claim: Additional index-1 cases of existence are established.
